channel.title: Writing — Ayush Srivastav
channel.description: Decision essays and build notes by Ayush Srivastav, filed under Travel, Tech, Education, and Tools.

item.title: Rings, Bands, Smartwatches, Sport Watches: Which Fitness Wearable Is Actually Yours
item.description: Twenty-eight devices across four form factors, scored on the nine things a fitness wearable can be good at. Describe your training week and the features you refuse to live without, and the page ranks the four categories for you, then ranks the devices inside the one that wins.

item.title: Kudremukh in a Day: 22 Kilometres Up Karnataka's Horse-Faced Peak
item.description: My first big Western Ghats climb, told in order: the midnight permit fight, a night bus with no reclining seats, a tent to myself in Kalasa, 11 kilometres up through streams and roots, a summit inside the cloud, and 11 kilometres back down in a storm.

item.title: The Himalayan Trek Calendar: Which Trek, Which Month, Which Year
item.description: Sixty-five Himalayan treks sorted by season, altitude, and difficulty into a four-quarter calendar. Which trail is safe in which month, what each one asks of you physically, and the order to attempt them in so that every year builds on the one before it.

item.title: Twelve Excel Timeplans, One Gantt: Everyone Keeps Their Own File
item.description: A single offline HTML file that opens every owner's own .xlsx, draws one master programme Gantt, resolves the dependencies they wrote in their own rows, and writes changes back to each source file without touching anyone else's.

item.title: iPhone Ownership in India: When to Buy, and the Year You Should Sell
item.description: Depreciation modelled from resale data, the Pro premium priced against the one feature that justifies it, and affordability tested against your own income.

item.title: Tap-to-Track: Eight Seconds From Purchase to Spreadsheet
item.description: Double-tap the back of an iPhone and a purchase lands in a Google Sheet you own. How the shortcut is wired, why the amount field does arithmetic without eval(), and how to set the whole thing up for yourself.

item.title: ISB vs IIM A/B/C: The Salary Where the Cheaper Option Flips
item.description: Fees, foregone salary, and loan interest for ISB's one-year MBA set against the two-year programmes at Ahmedabad, Bangalore, and Calcutta.

item.title: GMAT vs GRE: The Same Score Comes Easier on One of Them
item.description: Section by section through the GMAT Focus Edition and the GRE — scoring, adaptive design, question types, and where each exam punishes a different weakness.
